senses.gloss: m. (אנץ, ענץ, sec. r. of אוץ, עוץ) [tight bundle], only in pl. const. (עֲ) פשתן אֲנִיצֵי flax-stalks after they are soaked, beaten and baked.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:1">B. Mets. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21a">21ᵃ</cite>). Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ bot.; Bab.
<cite ref="Sukkah 12b">Succ. 12ᵇ</cite> (Ar., Ms. M., Tosef. ib. I, 6 <he>עניצי</he>); a. fr. V. <cite ref="A00743"><he>אוּנִין</he></cite>.
